posts.name: Bowie
posts.cooked:
DanMarshall14 and I met last month. Unsurprisingly, SotM made for a good conversation starter of a fast-developing game-friendship (and maybe I can rope him into costuming...)

I have also met Cam Banks, who is a forum user, um... three times? Four? At a few local events. I'm sure he also saw me in the TC Pride Parade, but doubt he noticed. Big fan of his since MHR days!

I look forward to attending GenCon next year, which is my plan, and hopefully I can meet more-- and maybe do some volunteering. Teaching and running these games pleases me very much. Especially if the RPG needs some help by then...
